title: European Allies Request a Larger American Commitment
summary: Allied capitals have formally requested additional American forces and enabling capabilities for a standing eastern deployment.
briefing_text: Council President Marchetti delivered a formal request for an additional American brigade, air defense, and the enabling capabilities that only we field, on a standing rather than rotational basis. The request is backed by eleven of the sixteen capitals and was accompanied by a private acknowledgement that European contributions have fallen short of commitments made three years ago. Refusal is survivable; a public refusal is not the same thing. The Council expects an answer before its summit in five weeks.

cabinet_assessment.state: The request is real and the shortfall in their own contributions is also real, Mr. President. Both things can be said, and how we say the second one determines what the first one costs us.
cabinet_assessment.defense: A standing brigade plus enablers is roughly forty billion across the profile and it comes out of the Pacific rotation, sir. I can do either mission well. I cannot do both well at this topline.
cabinet_assessment.treasury: Forty billion is financeable and it is not free. If you commit, I would rather it appear in the request than be absorbed quietly across three accounts.
cabinet_assessment.nsa: Whatever we decide becomes the alliance's planning assumption for a decade. I would be careful about how much we let a five-week summit deadline shape a ten-year commitment.
cabinet_assessment.chief_of_staff: If we send people, you need to be able to say when they come home. That is the question at every stop for the next two years, sir.
cabinet_assessment.intelligence: Allied services expect a yes and have planned on that basis. A refusal will produce a period of genuine strategic uncertainty in three capitals I would rather keep steady.

choices.label: Commit Additional Forces
choices.description: Approve the request in full: a standing brigade, air defense, and enabling capabilities.

advisor_positions.state: This settles the alliance question for a decade, Mr. President, and it removes our leverage on burden-sharing for just as long.
advisor_positions.defense: I can execute it, sir. It comes out of the Pacific rotation and I want that written into the decision memorandum, not discovered in testimony.
advisor_positions.chief_of_staff: Forty billion and an open-ended deployment in your first year. Be certain, because this one does not unwind.

headline.title: Allied Planning Consolidates Around the American Commitment
When Do They Come Home? The Question Nobody Will Answer

memory.action: approved the allied request for a standing deployment
memory.result: alliance reassured; cost and leverage both surrendered

choices.outcome_text: The commitment was announced jointly at the summit and received a standing ovation from people who had prepared for a refusal. The Pacific rotation was quietly rewritten the following week.

headlines.title: {president} Approves Standing Deployment for European Allies
Allied Capitals Register Relief as Washington Commits

choices.label: Support Tied to Burden-Sharing
choices.description: Approve a smaller package contingent on verified increases in allied defense spending.

advisor_positions.state: It is the honest position, Mr. President, and honest positions in alliance politics are received as insults for about a year before they are received as leadership.
advisor_positions.treasury: Twelve billion with a verification mechanism I can actually audit. Of the options in this room, it is the one I can defend line by line.

memory.action: allies met the verified spending benchmarks

headline.title: Allied Defense Budgets Clear the Agreed Benchmarks

memory.action: tied additional forces to verified burden-sharing
memory.result: partial commitment; conditions resented but accepted

choices.outcome_text: The package was approved with a verification annex that three capitals asked to have removed. It stayed in. The summit communiqué described the outcome as constructive, twice.

headlines.title: White House Ties New Forces to Allied Spending Benchmarks

choices.label: Offer Logistics and Intelligence Only
choices.description: Decline the force request but expand airlift, sustainment, and intelligence support.

advisor_positions.defense: It is cheap, it is real capability, and it is not what they asked for, sir. They will describe it as a refusal because that is what it is.
advisor_positions.intelligence: Expanded sharing buys us insight as well as goodwill, Mr. President. It also puts more of our collection in rooms we do not control.

delayed.label: Allied planning drifts from American assumptions

memory.action: allied planning diverged after the limited offer

headline.title: European Capitals Accelerate an Independent Capability Track

delayed.label: Reliability doubts spread to other partners

headline.title: Allies Wary as Washington Offers Less Than Asked

memory.action: offered enabling support instead of additional forces

choices.outcome_text: The offer expanded airlift and intelligence sharing at a fraction of the cost of the request. Council President Marchetti thanked the President publicly and, according to two officials, said something rather different in the room.

headlines.title: Washington Offers Logistics and Intelligence, Not Troops
Partners Read a Narrower American Commitment

choices.label: Open a Formal Alliance Review
choices.description: Defer the request and announce a comprehensive review of American commitments and their terms.

advisor_positions.chief_of_staff: It polls well at home and it buys us six months, Mr. President. That is genuinely all it does.
advisor_positions.state: A review is read abroad as a countdown, sir. Every capital will spend those six months hedging, and some of that hedging will not be reversible.
advisor_positions.nsa: Moscow will read this precisely as an opportunity, and they will be right to.

memory.action: allies hedged during the American alliance review

headline.title: Capitals Hedge as Washington Reviews Its Commitments

memory.action: opened a formal review of alliance commitments
memory.result: decision deferred; allied confidence badly damaged

choices.outcome_text: The review was announced as a routine assessment and understood by everyone as something else. Three capitals opened bilateral conversations with each other the same week.

headlines.title: {president} Orders Review of American Alliance Commitments
Allied Capitals Read a Review as a Countdown
